lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Thanks for joining, Maya. Can you tell me how you usually plan your weekly groceries?

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: Mostly on Sunday evening. I make a list on my phone, and then I order from whatever app has a free delivery slot.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Let's look at the checkout. What did you expect to happen when you tapped Pay?

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: Honestly, I thought it would show me the delivery time first. Instead it jumped straight to the card form, and I wasn't sure if my slot was still reserved.

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: A bit stressful. Last month I lost a slot that way, so now I take a screenshot of the time before I pay.

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: I skipped it. The word substitutions sounds like extra work. If it said, what should we do if something is out of stock, I would read it.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: If you could change one thing, what would it be?

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: Show the delivery slot and the total on the same screen, right next to the pay button.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Thanks, Jonas. How often do you order groceries online?

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: Every week, usually on my lunch break, so I have about ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Walk me through the checkout you just did.

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: It was fine until the payment page. I couldn't see when the delivery would arrive, so I scrolled back up to check the slot. That cost me a minute.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Did anything else slow you down?

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: The substitutions question. I didn't understand it, so I left the default. Later I got oat milk instead of regular milk, which was annoying.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: What would make you trust the checkout more?

lines.speaker: Participant
lines.text: A clear summary. Time, address, total. One screen. Then I would just press pay.
